presets.name: Glitter A · base
presets.notes: Primary recipe on the left lid; the same pigment without flakes on the right.

presets.name: Glitter B · mips
presets.notes: Identical base level (mirrored catalogue); only the mip chain differs.

presets.name: Glitter C · size
presets.notes: Flake width 0.12 / 0.25 / 0.5 mm, outer to inner; right lid mirrors with another seed.

presets.name: Glitter D · surface
presets.notes: Left: flake roughness 0.12 / 0.22 / 0.35 at metal 0.85. Right: metal 1.0 / 0.6 / 0.25 at roughness 0.22.

presets.name: Glitter E · accent
presets.notes: Primary on both lids; 8 % of the left lid's flakes also drive a mesh_decal_emissive_subsurface accent chunk.

accent.note: No UV transform in this template: the mask lives in the head UV atlas (2048 recommended, about 0.25 mm/texel on the lid); accent flakes are drawn at >= 2 texels there.

presets.name: Glitter F · tilt
presets.notes: Tilt spread sigma/max in degrees: 10/20, 25/50, 40/70, outer to inner.
